text: Looking for scale, safety, and dedicated resin manufacturing capacity? Welcome to MPD Industries' state-of-the-art greenfield plant in Ujjain. Two plants on one site, commissioned together. 22 reactors. Around 6,900 tons of rated output, every month. Plant 1 specializes in high-volume liquid coating resins, driven by 16 KL commercial powerhouses, on a site that scales from 2 KL pilot trials. Saturated polyester, alkyds, and modified epoxy: 4,373 tons a month, from day one. Plant 2 powers specialty and solid resins, backed by versatile finishing lines, including flakers, pelletisers, and product crushers. Reactive polyamide, powder polyester, acrylic polyols, phenolics, and R&D scale-up: 2,530 tons a month. Logistics are built for scale, with 600 KL of underground PESO solvent storage, and over 1,000 KL of dedicated finished-goods tanks. Twelve blenders add 380 KL of blending capacity, and grade-dedicated tanks keep every product clean. Built on eco-friendly power, driven by agro-waste thermic heaters, nitrogen blanketing, and zero-compromise ETP effluent treatment. Two 30 lakh kcal/h thermic heaters, a 2,200 TR cooling tower, and on-site nitrogen generation, sized for full load. Whether you need toll conversion, full-service jobwork, or dedicated plant capacity, partner with MPD Industries today. Every model comes with NDA confidentiality, segregated storage, and a scale-up path from 2 KL trials to 16 KL production. MPD Industries. We innovate. We serve.
